title: You Broke The Dirt Block!
description: A simple and lightweight Minecraft plugin that writes the message "You broke a dirt block" (in Russian) to the chat when a player breaks a dirt block.
body:
# You Broke The Dirt Block!

### EN:
A simple and lightweight Minecraft plugin that writes the message "You broke a dirt block" (in Russian) to the chat when a player breaks a dirt block.

### RU:
Простой и лёгкий плагин для Майнкрафт, который пишет в чат сообщение "Ты сломал блок грязи" когда игрок ломает блок грязи
